info.name: A New Skill for Blaze Wizards

descriptions.notStarted: If I think long and hard about #p1101002#'s words, that means I may be able to learn a new skill from #b#p1101004##k
descriptions.inProgress: #p1101004# told me there is indeed a new skill, but it's dangerous for me to learn the skill right now based on my level. He also proceeded to challenge me to prove that I deserve to learn the new skill. To prove it, I must head over to #m130020000#, enter #bthe 3rd Drill Hall#k, and bring back #t4032121#...\n\n#i4032121# #t4032121# #b#c4032121# / 1#k
descriptions.completed: I was able to defeat the boss monster and bring back #t4032121#. #p1101004# told me that I deserved to learn the new skill and taught me something called Ifrit.
